knowledgeAnswers.rationale: If the method cannot see the limit, the result cannot show the limit was met.
The source asks for the strictest of its listed criteria to be applied, so the limit is protective under every basis.
Detergent residue can contaminate the next product and can interfere with testing, so it is limited and tested.

practicalCriteria: Learner writes a limit basis for one named residue and states which test method will check it (pass: basis and method present).
Learner compares a limit with a stated detection limit and says whether the limit is measurable (pass: correct comparison).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written limit basis for one residue
Comparison of limit and detection limit
stopWorkCriteria: A limit is proposed with no written basis.
A limit is below what the test method can detect.
An allergenic or potent residue is on a shared line without a sign-off.
